card.fact_statement: Spellow Library, a community hub in Walton, was torched during the riots in Liverpool.
card.source_span: Spellow Library, a community hub in Walton was torched and wheelie bins set alight.

target_qa_variants.expected_answer: ห้องสมุดสเปลโลว์
target_qa_variants.source_span: Spellow Library, a community hub in Walton was torched and wheelie bins set alight.
